profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Disney Streaming
profile.geoLocationName: Staten Island, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack Developer in charge of adding visually interactive features to existing web applications and building internal tools using AngularJs and Java servers to help us become more efficient.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack developer where I helped build a micro-services application from the ground up.  We wrote our front-end as a SPA in AngularJs with the backend logic in Java. We followed an Agile process with Test Driven Development.  Being a small team, I also was very instrumental in building out our test, QA and Production environments on the Amazon AWS VPC cloud using a mix of Chef, Jenkins, Behat and some custom scripts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop our awesome application using a combination of magic [1] and knuckle grease. 

[1] Our magic includes but is not limited to the following famous stars: GWT, Java, FIX, ActiveMQ, Team Work, Agile, Open & Fun Work Environment and last but not least Go-Karts.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer for the Strategic Proposal System where I led a team of off-shore developers in building an Analytics Calculation and a Reporting Engine. The Calculation engine is used to calculate various data points for a proposal such as risk analysis metrics.  The Reporting Engine is used to build a custom PDF report of sections selected by the client.  This application runs on Pershing's proprietary iNautilus servers and was built using a combination of Java 5.0, XStream, XSL-FO and  FOP.

Lead Developer for the Client Meeting Preparation Tool, a java web service using FOP and multi-threaded techniques with a front end in .Net.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Involved through all phases of the SDLC for several J2EE applications using various technologies such as Spring Framework, Struts, MVC, JSP, JAXB, XSL-FO, FOP and AJAX
